# A code span inside a Markdown link renders as a placeholder

## Context

On neomjs.com, the post `#/news/blog/one-repository-per-reader` shows nine strings like `NEO_INLINE_CODE_5` where linked code names belong. A local dev server shows the same on `a-data-grid-in-a-web-worker` and on the memory post in neomjs/neo#20226. On `dev` (`f0e0e8e903`), 18 links in 6 published posts carry a code span in their text: `[`name`](url)`.

## The Problem

Observed (DOM, both sites): the link's text is the bold string `NEO_INLINE_CODE_<n>`. Cause, read in source: `Neo.component.Markdown#modifyMarkdown`, in the `replaceTicketIds` branch (`src/component/Markdown.mjs`, the steps commented 1–5):

1. Fenced code blocks become `__NEO_CODE_BLOCK_n__` tokens.
2. Inline code becomes `__NEO_INLINE_CODE_n__` tokens.
3. Links become `__NEO_LINK_n__` tokens. A link whose text held a code span now stores `[__NEO_INLINE_CODE_n__](url)`.
4. Ticket ids become links.
5. Tokens are restored in creation order. The code token is searched for first, but it now lives only inside the stored link, so it is never found. The link is restored afterwards with the code token still inside it, and Markdown renders `__…__` as bold.

The step-5 comment says "in reverse order to handle nesting", and the loop runs forward. Step 3 arrived with neomjs/neo#19912 (for #19900), and the first nesting came with it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `modifyMarkdown` is shared by every Markdown view that sets `replaceTicketIds`: portal blog posts, guides, tickets and release notes all pass through it.
- The spec `test/playwright/unit/component/Markdown.spec.mjs` covers a ticket id inside a link (from #19912). It has no case with a code span inside a link.

## The Fix

Restore the tokens in reverse creation order, so an outer token (a link) is put back before the inner token (a code span) it contains. Keep the function replacement from #18675, so `$` patterns in restored code stay literal. Add a spec for a code span inside a link, which also asserts that a bare `#N` still becomes a ticket link.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `modifyMarkdown('See [`openapi.yaml`](https://example.com/openapi.yaml) and #10074.\n')` keeps the link as written, contains no `NEO_INLINE_CODE`, and still links `#10074`.
- [ ] The existing Markdown specs pass, including #19912's link case and #18675's `$` case.
- [ ] Rendered in the portal: the memory post's two code-named links show their code text (post-merge on neomjs.com).

## Out of Scope

- Other placeholder kinds (`neo-component`, `mermaid` and `live-preview` blocks use their own extraction pass).

## Avoided Traps

- **Rewriting the posts.** Dropping the backticks from link text would hide the defect in six posts and leave it for the next one.
- **Protecting links before code.** That inverts the nesting for a link inside a code span, the case #8858 protects.
